# Check what changed after MOUSE click on magenta
before = last_transition.before_frame
after = last_transition.after_frame

before_seg = before.segmentation
after_seg = after.segmentation

# Check if magenta still exists

after_magenta = [n for n in after_seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'M']
print(f"Before magenta nodes: {len(before_magenta)}")
print(f"After magenta nodes: {len(after_magenta)}")

# Check score change

after_by_hash = {n['hash']: n for n in after_seg['nodes']}

print("\nChanged objects:")
for h in after_by_hash:
    if h in before_by_hash:
        b = before_by_hash[h]
        a = after_by_hash[h]
        if b['boundary'] != a['boundary']:
            b_rows = [p[0] for p in b['boundary']]
            a_rows = [p[0] for p in a['boundary']]
            b_cols = [p[1] for p in b['boundary']]
            a_cols = [p[1] for p in a['boundary']]
            print(f"  {a['color']}: from r{min(b_rows)}-{max(b_rows)},c{min(b_cols)}-{max(b_cols)} to r{min(a_rows)}-{max(a_rows)},c{min(a_cols)}-{max(a_cols)}")

# Check for new/removed objects
for h in after_by_hash:
    if h not in before_by_hash:
        print(f"  NEW: {after_by_hash[h]['color']}, pixels={after_by_hash[h]['pixels']}")
for h in before_by_hash:
    if h not in after_by_hash:
        print(f"  REMOVED: {before_by_hash[h]['color']}, pixels={before_by_hash[h]['pixels']}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
